publication.title: Genome-wide CRISPR screens of T cell exhaustion identify chromatin remodeling factors that limit T cell persistence

sources_inspected.name: GEO GSE203592 family SOFT
findings: one Mus musculus Perturb-seq sample, GSM6160064
sample source is in-vivo CRISPR screen of ex-vivo-expanded CD8-positive T cells and tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes
raw sequencing platform is GPL19057 / Illumina NextSeq 500
processed source reported by GEO is GSE203592_integrated_v2.rds.gz

sources_inspected.name: Cell article full text and Methods
findings: direct-capture Perturb-seq used 10x Chromium Next GEM Single Cell V(D)J 5-prime v1.1 with Feature Barcoding
the custom pool comprised four guides for each of nine targets and 12 non-targeting controls, 48 sgRNAs total
targeting guides were designed using the Broad GPP sgRNA Design Tool
tumor cells were recovered 15 days post adoptive transfer
each replicate was one tumor or two tumors from one mouse combined; captures split for yield were computationally merged

sources_inspected.name: Cell Table S2
findings: Table S2 reports the selected genes and in-vivo screen statistics
Table S2 does not publish sgRNA nucleotide sequences or per-guide stable identifiers

sources_inspected.name: Ensembl release 93 mouse GTF
findings: the 31,053-row source-symbol axis maps deterministically to unique ENSMUSG identifiers above the 99 percent acceptance threshold
Seurat make.unique suffix order resolves duplicate release-93 gene_name rows only when the source and axis multiplicities match
remaining ambiguous symbols retain an explicit source-symbol feature_index fallback

sources_inspected.name: current exact Lamin OBS/X/VAR readback
findings: OBS has 70,646 unique source-preserved cell_barcode/original_obs_index rows
experiment_id contains eight tumor/capture aggregates and orig_batch contains V35/V41
orig_guide contains 48 specific guide labels plus aggregate zMulti/zNone labels
source-preserved nCount_RNA, nFeature_RNA and percent.mt are complete
accepted X is 70,646 by 31,053 and is unchanged by this task
the prior VAR was incorrectly mapped against human Ensembl and contained only 14 ENSG identifiers

guide_sequence.reason: GEO, the paper Methods, the Key Resources Table, and Table S2 identify the 48-guide library but do not publish the nucleotide sequences; Broad GPP design-tool provenance is insufficient to reconstruct exact selected guides without stable guide identifiers
guide_sequence.projection_guard: do not substitute newly designed or current GPP candidate sequences for the unpublished historical library

perturbation_target_id.reason: source provides mouse gene symbols but no stable target-ID namespace; do not infer a target ID independently of the exact guide library

donor_id.reason: publication describes tumor/mouse replicate aggregation but the released cell table does not expose a stable donor/mouse identifier beyond experiment_id

sex.reason: female tumor hosts are reported, but the transferred Pmel-1 donor T-cell sex is not cell-level joinable and is not projected

age.reason: mouse age is not present in the released cell metadata

pct_ribo.reason: not supplied in released cell metadata and not recomputed because this task does not rewrite X

is_low_quality.reason: source-preserved scrub/scrub_score values are not documented as a binary low-quality decision

not_applicable_fields.cell_line: the assayed cells are primary mouse CD8-positive tumor-infiltrating T cells; MC38 is the tumor model, not the assayed cell line

reported_sources_not_claimed_inspected.reason: the current PRISM OBS preserves the complete released Seurat metadata columns needed for exact row-level curation; no claim is made that the 2.7G RDS payload was reloaded by this task
raw sequencing reads cannot recover unpublished guide design sequences or sample metadata joins without a separately specified reprocessing contract

join_contract.cell_identity: cell_barcode equals original_obs_index for all 70,646 rows and remains unique
join_contract.sample: experiment_id is preserved as the source tumor/capture aggregate
join_contract.guide: only orig_guide labels matching the 36 target-guide or 12 CTRL1-guide identifiers become guide_id; zMulti/zNone aggregate classes remain unknown guide identities
join_contract.control: source is_control must exactly agree with condition == control
join_contract.var: VAR symbols remain in exact accepted X order; Ensembl release-93 gene_name mapping is species-correct and ambiguous rows use source-symbol fallback

allowed_writes: accepted X to revised VAR link
